jobs.description:
**Job Description**: Develop sim2real reinforcement learning (RL) training pipelines for humanoid robots. Train and test robot policies via reinforcement learning for in-home humanoid robots. Optimize training pipelines for improved performance and training speed. Modeling of physical systems (including robot dynamics, sensor modeling, contact parameter tuning) to close the gap between simulation and physical systems. Collecting, cleaning and retargeting human motion data for use in RL training pipelines. Supporting the test and debug of RL policies in simulation and on physical hardware.  
  
**Requirements**: Master’s degree or foreign degree equivalent in Robotics, AI/Machine Learning, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and one (1) year of experience in a Robotics & Machine Learning occupation or related in the job offered.  
  
**Skills:**  
  
Experience and/or education must include:

* Rigid body dynamics and/or dynamical systems for training, deploying and testing reinforcement learned policies for humanoid robots.
* Implement production-grade Python code for reinforcement learning (RL) and other machine learning training pipelines.
* Reinforcement learned algorithms, techniques, and sim2real approaches as they pertain to robotics to perform various human-like capabilities, including whole-body loco-manipulation.
* Implement and debug real-time software in C++ deployed on robots to satisfy various real-time constraints.
* Model physical systems, including multi-body hybrid dynamic systems with contact, in a simulated environment to identify gaps between simulation and hardware and the ability to understand how to accurately model the hardware in simulation.
* Root-cause analysis as it pertains to robotic systems and the ability to quickly troubleshoot issues.
* Forward and inverse kinematics as they pertain to humanoid system training using human motion data.

Compensation Range: $130,146 - $300,000

**About the role**

We want Tesseract to render 3D that is indistinguishable from footage. You'll be the founding engineer for photoreal 3D in Tesseract, our Rust-based, cross-platform graphics and media rendering engine.

Tesseract already renders video, motion graphics, effects and compositing in a color- managed pipeline. You'll build 3D to the same standard: a fast interactive preview for editing, and a physically based final render, path-traced or hybrid ray-traced, that produces film-quality frames for export. Both run from one scene, material and lighting model, so what people see while they edit is what they export.

Scenes are authored by people and by AI agents, so render cost, failure modes and APIs matter as much as image quality. This is a foundational role: you'll make the core architectural decisions and help build the team around them.

**What you'll do**

* Define the architecture for photoreal 3D: how ray tracing, rasterization and denoising divide the work, and how that maps onto Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D and WebGPU.

* Build a physically based model for materials, lights and cameras: energy-conserving materials (metal, glass, clearcoat, sheen, translucency), lights in real-world units, and a camera with exposure, depth of field and motion blur.
* Own image quality: sampling, antialiasing, accumulation, denoising and firefly suppression, with frames that stay stable and deterministic across a video export.
* Scale scenes to production complexity with acceleration structures, instancing, culling and memory management, for millions of triangles and tens of thousands of objects.
* Integrate 3D into Tesseract's video, motion graphics and compositing pipeline, including ACES color management and render passes such as depth, normals, motion vectors and light groups.
* Make render cost predictable and rendering robust: performance budgets, profiling, and headless batch rendering on local and cloud GPUs.
* Design 3D APIs that work for people and AI agents alike: a clear scene representation, actionable validation errors, fast previews and render cost known before the render.
* Work with engine, product and AI teams, and help hire and grow the 3D rendering team.

**What makes you a great fit**

* Deep experience building physically based renderers in production: film or offline renderers, path tracers, or game engines with ray-traced or hybrid lighting.

* Hands-on experience with Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU, including compute shaders, GPU profiling and GPU debugging.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, with strong reasoning about memory, concurrency and performance.
